written.myAnswer: Spreadsheet software organizes and stores data in rows and columns, performs calculations, analyzes data, and creates charts.
In education, graphic design software can be used to create visual learning materials such as diagrams, illustrations, and posters.

Word processing software creates, edits, formats, and prints text documents. Spreadsheet software organizes and analyzes data, performs calculations, and creates charts. Presentation software creates slide shows to communicate information using text, images, charts, and other media. Graphic design software creates and edits visual content such as illustrations and logos.
